summary: SPLIT PACKET 2 of 2 — tools/governor/reorient.mjs, THE REPAIRS ONLY (range 2aac7d9..HEAD). WHY THIS IS SPLIT, stated plainly because a split packet must never look like a whole one. reorient.mjs's full diff against the merge base is 80,945 bytes against this tool's 60,000 cap, so it CANNOT be reviewed in one packet and would truncate silently if attempted — a truncated review is a verdict over ground the reviewer never examined, which is the exact failure this phase exists to treat. The change is therefore gated in two range packets. PACKET 1 (a989e68..2aac7d9, the DECOUPLING) is reviewed separately and covers the surgical removal of the programme-state and rotate-session dependencies. THIS PACKET covers everything done since: the repairs to the location block's honesty. The limit that follows, and it is disclosed rather than implied: NO SINGLE REVIEWER SEES THE COMPLETE FINAL FILE. Each acceptance criterion is gated exactly once, by a reviewer that can see the code it concerns. CONTEXT. reorient.mjs is the SessionStart hook — the first thing that speaks in every session, and the component whose entire job is to tell the operator whether what he is shown was MEASURED or ASSUMED. It renders a block headed 'WHERE THIS SESSION IS (executed, not assumed)' and closing 'These are facts, not an approval to implement.' WHAT THIS RANGE FIXES, and every one of these was a sentence the block printed without having earned it. (1) cwd was the caller's own argument handed straight back, unmeasured, so a path that did not exist on disk rendered verbatim beneath that heading — proven by execution, and live: a real session opened with 'cwd : c:/Fusion247PKA' (lowercase, supplied by the harness) beside 'repo root : C:/Fusion247PKA' (uppercase, from git), the case mismatch being the fingerprint of one value being supplied and the other measured. (2) A NON-STRING cwd passed through unchanged and rendered as a path. (3) A cwd resolving to a FILE rendered as an established location, because the first repair measured EXISTENCE where the claim requires DIRECTORY-NESS. (4) branch rendered the literal 'HEAD' on a detached checkout, indistinguishable from a branch actually named HEAD. (5) upstream asserted '(none tracked — nothing here is pushed)' whenever a coarse git-readability flag was true — but that flag asks 'did any git command work here' and was being used to answer 'is this branch pushed'. On a DETACHED HEAD, rev-parse --git-dir succeeds while @{u} fails, so the block claimed nothing was pushed about commits that may well be pushed. (6) repo root OVERCLAIMED on the common case: --show-toplevel returns the WORKTREE root, and this estate is mostly linked worktrees. (7) The deliverables sweep collapsed FIVE states into one byte-identical rendering, one of them being 'I could not look', and per-file read failures were silently skipped even when the section rendered, so a shown list could be incomplete with no tell. HOW THIS WAS APPROACHED, because it bears on what you should attack. Three prior rounds each fixed the INSTANCE and missed the CLASS — the reviewer found one, the builder found a second that both the reviewer and I had missed, and the reviewer then found two more in the builder's own repair. So this range stops fixing instances and instead ENUMERATES the block's claim surface: every rendered field, what it claims to a reader, the exact measurement behind it, every way that measurement can fail, and what the reader sees in each case, held to a four-state test — measured / nothing was claimed / something was claimed and it did not check out / I could not tell. Any two of those rendering identically IS the defect. The enumeration is PINNED by a test asserting the rendered label set equals a literal held in the TEST file, never derived from the renderer it checks, so adding or renaming a field goes RED. I mutation-tested that pin myself by injecting a ninth field and watching it fail. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: the tests for this module are in reorient.test.mjs, whose diff also exceeds the cap and CANNOT be staged, so they get no independent read at all — this module is the one component of the teardown with neither independent test review nor CI coverage, since governor-tests.yml excludes that suite. The true-casing behaviour is proven on win32 only. continuity.mjs and continuity-derive.mjs have NO tests whatsoever. All evidence is builder self-test plus my own independent re-run of every number and probe. It is NOT independent review.
brief_excerpt:
Judge this diff against these criteria and ONLY these.

SCOPE — read first. This packet contains tools/governor/reorient.mjs ONLY, and ONLY the range 2aac7d9..HEAD, which is the REPAIRS. The packet's diff_range states this explicitly. The earlier decoupling of this same file is a SEPARATE packet with its own claim; do not judge the decoupling here, and do not treat its absence as a gap. Rows about any other file are OUT OF SCOPE — mark them not_applicable, never blocked. The tests live in reorient.test.mjs, which cannot be staged untruncated and is NOT in this packet: do not report tests as missing, and do not infer from their absence that they do not exist.

Y1. ATTACK THE cwd REPAIR. It must establish that the path is a DIRECTORY the session can be in, not merely that it resolves. Find any input that still renders as an established location without being one. Consider: a path that exists but is not a directory; a symlink or junction; a UNC path; a path that exists but is unreadable; the empty string; a boolean, number, array or object supplied as cwd; and a path that resolves but on which git nonetheless partially fails. Name concrete inputs, not categories.

Y2. ATTACK THE upstream REPAIR. The confident sentence '(none tracked — nothing here is pushed)' must be printed ONLY where a probe specifically established that an attached branch has no configured upstream. Verify no other state can reach it — detached HEAD, unborn branch, absent remote config, a failing probe, or a branch name containing a delimiter used by the probe. This is the row where a wrong answer re-creates the original defect in the opposite direction, which is harder to notice than the original.

Y3. ATTACK THE FOUR-STATE DISTINGUISHABILITY. For every field in the block, can a reader tell 'measured' from 'nothing was claimed' from 'something was claimed and it did not check out' from 'I could not tell'? The whole purpose of the repair is that the difference is visible to a HUMAN reading the line, not merely present in the data. Any two rendering identically is the defect.

Y4. ATTACK THE ENUMERATION'S COMPLETENESS. This is the one thing the builder's own pin cannot test, and it is the most valuable row in this packet. The pin asserts that the rendered field set matches a literal list — but it cannot tell anyone whether the enumeration's MODEL of failure is complete. Is there a failure mode, for any field, that the enumeration does not account for and that would render as something other than what it claims? If the enumeration has a hole, the method failed rather than the luck ran out, which is a different and more important finding than any single defect.

Y5. The sweep must distinguish 'I swept and there is nothing' from 'I could not read'. Verify that an unreadable directory, an unreadable file among readable ones, and a genuinely empty result are all distinguishable to a reader, and that a rendered list which is INCOMPLETE says so.

Z1. THE HOOK MUST NEVER THROW and must always exit 0. It runs at session start; if it throws, the operator's first contact with the session is a crash or, worse, silence. This range ADDS filesystem and git probes to that boot path, so this row is materially more exposed than before. Verify every added probe degrades to a reported absence rather than an exception.

Z2. THE HOOK MUST NEVER REPORT A STATE IT DID NOT MEASURE. Find any path where any field could be rendered as fact from a default, a stale value, or a silently swallowed failure. A confidently-rendered wrong location is strictly worse than no location, because the operator acts on it.

Z3. The honesty claims themselves — the heading 'executed, not assumed' and the closing 'These are facts' — must still be TRUE of every line beneath them. If any line still cannot support them, the sentence is the defect, not the heading.

ADVERSARIAL ROWS.
W1. Does any repair introduce a NEW way to be wrong? Each added probe is another thing that can fail, and a probe whose failure is misread is worse than no probe.
W2. Can any of the block's fields fail SILENTLY — producing output indistinguishable from a healthy one? Name the concrete input.
W3. The checkout-kind suffix (primary versus linked worktree) is measured. Can it be wrong, or attached to the wrong field?

OUT OF SCOPE — do not report as defects: the decoupling itself, which is the separate packet; which modules the operator kept or deleted; prose, naming or comment-style preference; the absence of tests from this packet; the exclusion of reorient.test.mjs from CI, which is disclosed and is the operator's to close; and the absence of malicious-handler hardening, since this estate's bar is correctness, accidental leak, availability and audit for a first-party personal system, not a hostile-input service.
